scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').toLowerCase(); const pm=(process.env.npm_config_package_manager||'').toLowerCase(); const exec=(process.env.npm_execpath||'').toLowerCase().split(String.fromCharCode(92)).join('/'); const ok=/\bpnpm\/11\./.test(ua)||/^pnpm@11\./.test(pm)||/pnpm\/11\./.test(exec); if(!ok){console.error('ERROR: Use pnpm@11.x only in this repository.'); process.exit(1)}"
